content:
Current best measurements put the age of the universe at about:

**13.8 billion years**  
More precisely: **13.8 ± 0.02 billion years**

This value mainly comes from observations of the **cosmic microwave background** (especially by the Planck satellite), combined with our best cosmological model (ΛCDM: Lambda Cold Dark Matter).
